text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Today is Valentine's Day. For Gold City, being as popular as she is, it might be the toughest day of the entire year. Just in case, I decide to check in on her…

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer. What are you doing here?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: What? Am I supposed to be carrying something?
choice_data_list: I thought you'd have received some chocolates by now.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: …Ah, I see. For Valentine's Day.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: I have. In the form of words—"Happy Valentine's Day."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Yup. I told everyone not to give me any physical gifts this year, even the students here.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Every year prior, I'd be bombarded with insane amounts of stuff combined with what I get from fans.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: A lot of people were thoughtful enough to give me stuff besides food, like accessories and cosmetics, but still, it was just too much.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: So for this year…

text_block_list.name: Younger Student
text_block_list.text: Happy Valentine's Day, City!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Thanks. I appreciate your thoughtfulness. Happy Valentine's Day to you too.

text_block_list.name: Younger Student
text_block_list.text: Eep! Th-thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: How's that for an example? Words—just like I asked.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Getting to see them and talk face to face makes me happier than any old gift.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Anyway, you giving me anything or what?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: If you're just here to waste time, I'd rather get going.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Huh… It actually feels weird to hear it from you.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Do you even, like, mean it? You know it's supposed to be a gift, right?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: I mean… if that's all you got, it's fine. Not like you can force someone into being thoughtful.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Yeah, forget it. I'm just buzzing from all the word-gifts I've already gotten today.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Geez, way to blow my eardrums out.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Sure, maybe… but not because you were loud. This isn't some yelling contest.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Anyway… I guess it's my turn then.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Happy Valentine's Day, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: So… did you really just come here to bother me or what?
choice_data_list: Bother you? I was just worried.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: About Valentine's Day? You mean it hasn't occurred to you I might be used to all this?
choice_data_list: You're right. You didn't need any help.
You're right. You didn't need any help.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: That said… you came at the right time, actually. Here.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Happy Valentine's Day.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: For all the things you do for me.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: What—are you nervous? Either way, it's a skin care set inside.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: I put in a variety of brands for you to try, so let me know which one works best.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Afterwards, I'll send you a set of that brand. I can check it for you too.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Why are you acting so shy all of a sudden? Is it so weird for me to give you stuff?
choice_data_list: No, it's not! I really like it.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Good to hear, then.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: As I said, you do a lot for me.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: And I make you worry a bunch, so I don't really think this is enough to repay you.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: But… you know, it's the least I can do.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Try them, okay? I'll be able to tell if you're not using them.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: We'll see if you're as serious as you sound.
